title: PHD2 Guiding RMS by Target Altitude
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=phd2:guide
| search total_rms_arcsec=*
| stats avg(total_rms_arcsec) as avg_rms_arcsec max(total_rms_arcsec) as max_rms_arcsec by target_name altitude_bucket
| sort 0 - avg_rms_arcsec
description: Ranks target-altitude combinationss by guiding RMS.
value: Altitude often explains guiding quality, so splitting by target and bucket makes the mechanical limits easier to see.
implementation: Send guiding RMS events to `index=personal` and keep `target_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of guiding RMS by target-altitude combinations.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds which target-altitude combinationss stand out most for guiding RMS.
